data.title: Dow Crashes 1,100 Points as Investor Sentiment Sours, Fear and Greed Index Falls Into 'Extreme Fear'
data.description: U.S. stocks fell sharply Thursday as CNN’s Fear & Greed Index hit Extreme Fear at 19. Dow plunged 1,101 points; Anthropic opened 34% above its IPO price.

data.title: Rand Paul Says US Debt Could Rise By At Least $8 Trillion In 4 Years: ‘Not an Iota of Difference’ In Spending Between Republicans and Democrats
data.description: Rand Paul warns of $8 trillion debt increase, criticizing bipartisan spending and continued military borrowing.

data.title: Kevin O’Leary Bets Anthropic Could Be the Next Amazon: Why the Shark Tank Star Calls Its Strategy ‘Sheer Genius’
data.description: Kevin O’Leary praised Anthropic’s enterprise AI strategy, comparing its growth potential to Amazon after its record $81.3 billion IPO.

data.title: ‘What’s Foolish’ Is Allowing Billionaires to ‘Undermine Our Democracy’: Bernie Sanders Vows Elon Musk Will Not Have That Opportunity Again
data.description: Sanders rebukes Musk’s regret over $445M election spending, blaming billionaire influence and urging limits on super PAC donations.

data.title: Dogecoin Tests Historic Support Level That Preceded 760% Rally, Analyst Sees Potential for Another Rebound
data.description: Dogecoin retests $0.054 support that preceded a 760% rally, as Ali Martinez sees potential for another significant rebound.
